question: Which freedom fighter was also the first woman to become the Governor of Uttar Pradesh State?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarojini Naidu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarojini Naidu** was a **freedom fighter** and **social activist** who played a key role in India's struggle for **independence.**
 
• She was also the first woman to become the** Governor of Uttar Pradesh, **serving from **1947 to 1949.**
 
• Naidu was known as the **Nightingale of India **for her **poetry and literary works.**
 
• She was a **close associate of Mahatma Gandhi **and participated in various movements such as the **Non-Cooperation Movement **and the **Salt Satyagraha.**
 
• Naidu was also a prominent member of the **Indian National Congress **and served as its **President in 1925.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajkumari Amrit Kaur **was a **freedom fighter and social reformer **who played a significant role in the Indian independence movement.

 
 
• She was the **first Health Minister of India **and also served as the** President of the All India Women's Conference.**
 
 
 
• **Rani Lakshmi Bai, **also known as the Queen of Jhansi, was a **warrior and freedom fighter **who fought against the British during the** Indian Rebellion of 1857.**
 
 
• She is remembered for her** bravery and sacrifice** in the face of adversity.
 
 
 
• **Kasturba Gandhi** was the **wife of Mahatma Gandhi **and actively participated in various movements for India's independence.
 
 
• She was also a **social activist **and worked towards the **empowerment of women **and the** upliftment of the underprivileged sections** of society.
